title: Sharing capacity has its own access policy
when: A teammate should be able to run workers on this machine
need: Machine access.use controls owner-only, selected actors, project-role or universe use. The offers block is reserved and is not enforced for placement, deploys or QA; never treat its presence as a restriction.
surface: Machine register/settings help and source contract expose the policy; natural discovery from the dashboard or launch blocker was not traced.
gap: This is an implemented contract with an untraced human/agent entry cue, not absent support.
